responsibility: Implements the front end’s symbol-to-GCC-tree mapping table using an indexed lookup from Modula-2 symbol numbers to `m2tree.Tree` pointers. It stores permanent and temporary associations, rejects error-node or poisoned backend objects, marks out-of-scope mappings with a front-end poison sentinel, answers whether GCC already knows about a symbol, and ties constant handling back into semantic evaluation by triggering `M2ALU.PushTypeOfTree`/`SymbolTable.PopValue` when an unresolved constant finally acquires its GCC representation.
same_name_distinction: This `.mod` file realizes the SymbolConversion API with an `Index`-backed table from symbol numbers to `m2tree.Tree` values, including poison checking, temporary `GetErrorNode()` entries, and constant finalization hooks; `SymbolConversion.def` only declares those entry points.
